messages.author: dff5812abd02f177
messages.subject: Analysis Stops after 2 files
parts:
Hello!
I have over 800 files (each is an individual person), each with about 7 days of (ideally) 24 hour wear time. GGIR has produced results with only the error 'stop reading because there is not enough data in this block' for only the first 2 files in the directory folder. In trying to solve, I've removed files from the folder to eliminate the possibility that it's a file. All efforts have resulted in GGIR only analyzing and outputting results for only the first 2 files in the folder.

Can you advise?

Thank you!

- Jonathan K.

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Analysis Stops after 2 files
parts:
Hi Jonathan,
Change f1 = 2 to f1 = c()
This will make that g.shell.GGIR processes as many files as there are in the data folder.
At the moment you instruct it to only process the first two files (f0=1 and f1=2), which by the way is a useful feature if you want to test your analyses before processing all your files.
Best wishes,
Vincent
